  "source_groundedness": 0.82,
  "rationale": "The added columns decompose reviews into multiple genuine thematic axes (craft, writing, plot, acting, emotion, rewatch, benchmarking, recommendation, genre expectation), all directly supporting the query about how themes differ by sentiment and offering real grouping/comparison leverage beyond the binary label. Minor groundedness risk comes from a few graded categories (rewatch intent, recommendation strength, genre expectation) being inferred from overall tone rather than explicit statements, and some correlation with the sentiment label, but no clear hallucinations were observed in the samples."
